textNodes.text: The hardware, apps and small things I use every day to design and build products. No sponsors — just what earned its place.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Figma, Blender and a dev server at once — the fans stay quiet.
5K for pixel checks, and the colour matches the phones I test on.
Heavy, quiet and remapped for Figma shortcuts.
The side wheel scrubs timelines in Rive and Framer.
Flows, UI and the design system's source of truth.
Marketing sites that clients can edit on their own.
Interactive motion that ships as a tiny runtime.
Prettier, ESLint and one calm theme.
Every product UI I build ends up here.
App router and server components — fast by default.
Tokens from Figma, straight into utility classes.
A preview link on every pull request for client review.
Bought used in 2019. Best money I've spent.
Warm light for sketching after dark.
Dot grid. Every project starts on paper.
